All tests pass successfully. Test coverage includes:

| Test case | Input | Output | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Empty string | `""` | `""` | ✅ |
| Single character | `"a"` | `"a"` | ✅ |
| ASCII palindrome | `"racecar"` | `"racecar"` | ✅ |
| ASCII word | `"hello"` | `"olleh"` | ✅ |
| Sentence with spaces | `"hello world"` | `"dlrow olleh"` | ✅ |
| Unicode (café) | `"café"` | `"éfac"` | ✅ |
| Unicode emoji | `"😊🌟"` | `"🌟😊"` | ✅ |
| Unicode mixed | `"Hello, 世界"` | `"界世 ,olleH"` | ✅ |
| Numbers | `"12345"` | `"54321"` | ✅ |
| Special chars | `"!@#$%"` | `"%$#@!"` | ✅ |
| **Reverse twice** (identity check) | Various | Original | ✅ |

Edge cases handled:
- **Empty string** → loop never runs, returns `""`
- **Single rune** → loop never runs, returns the rune unchanged
- **Multi-byte UTF-8** → rune conversion preserves codepoint boundaries
- **Emoji/4-byte codepoints** → handled correctly by Go's `[]rune` conversion
